entities.name: Ghed
entities.description: Coastal city, one of the twelve Southern City-States during the Dark Age of Terisiare.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Fled the Church of Tal to Ghed, peddled healing wares and joined the army of Ghed.

entities.name: Sima
entities.description: Discovered Jodah with the Church after his Alabaster Potion healed its recipients.

entities.name: Battle of Pitdown
entities.description: Battle in which Jodah found himself with the army of Ghed.

entities.name: Kjeldor
entities.description: Nation that later included Ghed territory.

events.summary: Jodah flees the Church of Tal to Ghed and is trapped when a plague locks the city down.
events.quote: Jodah came to the city fleeing the Church of Tal

events.summary: Sima and the Church discover Jodah after his Alabaster Potion heals its recipients.
events.quote: was discovered by Sima and the Church when an Alabaster Potion he had made healed its recipients

events.summary: Jodah joins the army of Ghed in its war against Alsoor, ending up in the Battle of Pitdown.
events.quote: Jodah joined the army of Ghed in its war against Alsoor
